title: 第25章谁是螳螂谁是黄雀第26章小漏底细
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
听到这话，许是脑子一抽，又或者是别的原因，许峰突然说道：“那师父，我能先有一套替代品么？”
师父手微微一停，旋即说道：“可。不过还需要一些时间，并且这针，你我都要做，却也都做不得。
想要做针，还须得你我师徒前去外头定做，我们的针，不比寻常，逢集上的货郎不卖我们要的针线。
想要咱们的针，要去的是大远镇，只有那里，才有合了我们心意的针。
不过你想好，不要我的针，你的针就要自己养了。”
许峰闻言，说道：“自己养就自己养罢！我也想要助师父一臂之力，就算不成一臂之力，稍微能帮师父，我也是高兴的。”
许峰倒是没说虚假。
他是真的想要辅助自己的师父。
无论如何，他都要护住自己师父的性命！所以他的这话发自真心。
真心话一出。
肉眼可见的，师父更加高兴！
他一边说，一边缝合：“你小子倒是机灵、嘴甜。罢了，过要是你真的能好好地缝住了这六具尸体，我就给你打一套针。
有了这一套针，你也就是一位正经的缝尸人了！”
许峰：“好，谢谢师父！”
师父失笑：“倒是会顺杆子往上爬的很！像是一只皮猴子。”
这边气氛刚刚缓和了下来，说到了这里，那门外敲门的声音，终于连风声都掩盖不住了，连带着猫叫都凄厉无比，甚至于猫已经不在社庙外头，而到了社庙里头来了！
猫在屋顶上乱走，许峰想要抬头盯着“出气口”。
那竹竿顶起来的“出气口”。
一只猫下来，绰绰有余。
许峰可没有忘记自己所学，要是这猫落下来，落在了尸体上，这尸体一定会起尸！不过还未抬头，师父就阻止了他的动作。

“专心，我还在这里，轮不到你来操心外头的事情！”
解释完了针法之后，师父示意许峰上手，许峰小心翼翼地缝合着，问道：“师父，去不去外头看一眼？”
师父说道：“不去看了，就是这光景，外头应该是有想要找替身的淹死鬼。
还有几只猫作为邪祟过来。
真正麻烦的，其实还是在这草席下面的男尸！
这黄河里头的淹死鬼也有些麻烦，黄河里头的东西，连土地老爷都管不得。至于那几只猫，只要猫后头的人还在罗阴县，他就不得放肆。”
师父说的稳定，许峰也全然就当做这么一听。
不过话说罢之后。
师父也清楚，要是光这个还好，就怕这里头，还牵扯到了别的东西，这样驱尸赶鬼的本事，叫他想到了一些人。
土火教。
且这黄河之中的尸体和这几具尸体一起送来，总是叫他心里不安宁的很。按理来说，土火教的人想要对付他这样一个缝尸人，不应该用这样的手段。
明刀明枪来即可。
说不清楚。
师父手持火把，站在一边，示意许峰将自己所学，用在这实践上，至于他本人，更是观看着周围！
在许峰出去“放饭”的时候，实则他也已经在西房外头做好了准备。
今晚的凶险，只要扛到天亮，便无须担心。
故而还是今天晚上，他的手段有三。
一为社庙，但是现在看来，社庙已开，就算如此，那些孤魂野鬼亦不敢进来。换句话说，敢进来的，亦非孤魂野鬼。
二为灯笼所照之地，不过现在看来，那灯笼估计也撑不住多久时间。
第三，便是为西房门的石雕了。

此刻，西房门口，淡淡的香火味道笼罩着那狰狞的石雕，那石雕目光之中，两道红光亮起，而在社庙的院子之中，一只湿漉漉的脚印出现又消失。
他一出现。
content_en:
Hearing this, perhaps his brain twitched, or for other reasons, Xu Feng suddenly said: "Master, can I get a replacement first?"
The master's hand paused slightly and then said: "Yes. But it will still take some time, and even if you and I have to do this injection, we can't do it.
If you want to make needles, you and I, the masters and apprentices, have to go out and customize them. Our needles are unusual, and the sellers at the market will not sell the needles and threads we want.
If we want our needles, we have to go to Dayuan Town. Only there can we find needles that suit our needs.
But if you think about it, if you don’t want my needles, you will have to raise your own needles. "
Xu Feng heard this and said: "You can support yourself by yourself! I also want to help Master. Even if it is not a helping hand, I will be happy if I can help Master a little."
Xu Feng didn't say it was false.
He really wants to help his master.
No matter what, he must protect his master's life! So what he said came from the bottom of his heart.
The truth comes out.
Visible to the naked eye, Master is even happier!
He said while sewing: "You are smart and sweet-tongued. But if you can really sew these six corpses properly, I will give you a set of injections."
With this set of needles, you will be a serious corpse stitcher! "
Xu Feng: "Okay, thank you Master!"
The master laughed: "You can climb up the pole very well! Like a skinned monkey."
The atmosphere here had just calmed down. At this point, the sound of knocking on the door could not even be covered up by the wind. Even the meowing of the cat was so shrill and shrill that the cat was no longer outside the temple, but was inside the temple!
The cat was walking around on the roof, and Xu Feng wanted to raise his head and stare at the "air outlet".
The "air outlet" held up by the bamboo pole.
One cat down, more than enough.
Xu Feng has not forgotten what he has learned. If the cat falls down and lands on a corpse, the corpse will definitely rise up! But before he could raise his head, his master stopped him.
"Concentrate, I'm still here, it's not your turn to worry about things outside!"
After explaining the stitching technique, the master motioned for Xu Feng to start. Xu Feng carefully sutured and asked: "Master, would you like to go outside and take a look?"
The master said: "Don't go and look. This is the scene. There should be a drowned ghost outside who is looking for a substitute.
There are also several cats that come as evil spirits.
The real trouble is actually the male corpse under this straw mat!
The drowned ghosts in the Yellow River are also in some trouble. Even the land lord has no control over the things in the Yellow River. As for those cats, as long as the person behind the cats is still in Luoyin County, he is not allowed to act recklessly. "
The master said it was stable, and Xu Feng took it as such.
But after saying that.
The master also knew that if this alone was fine, he was afraid that something else might be involved. This ability to exorcise corpses and ghosts reminded him of some people.
Earth Fire Cult.
And the corpse in the Yellow River was brought together with these corpses, which always made him feel very uneasy. Logically speaking, people from the Earth and Fire Sect should not use such methods if they want to deal with a corpse stitcher like him.
Just use a clear sword or a clear gun.
Can't tell.
The master held a torch and stood aside, signaling Xu Feng to use what he had learned in practice. As for himself, he was watching the surroundings!
When Xu Feng went out to "put out food", he was actually already making preparations outside the west room.
There is no need to worry about tonight's danger as long as we can bear it until dawn.
So tonight, he has three methods.
One is the temple, but now it seems that the temple is open. Even so, those lonely ghosts dare not come in. In other words, those who dare to come in are not lonely ghosts.
The second is the place illuminated by the lantern, but now it seems that the lantern may not last long.
The third one is the stone carving of the west door.
now,At the door of the west room, the faint smell of incense enveloped the ferocious stone sculpture. In the gaze of the stone sculpture, two red lights lit up, and in the courtyard of the temple, a wet footprint appeared and disappeared.
As soon as he appeared.
